purpose: OpenGameAgent P0 acceptance workload only; not a product, runtime, or embedding-model default

evidence.recordCount: host-required P0 acceptance workload: one owner partition contains exactly ten thousand active records
evidence.dimensions: reference-derived: this synthetic acceptance profile aligns with BGE-M3's fixed vector width; BGE-M3 remains optional and is not a product default
evidence.warmupQueryCount: derived: zero warmups preserve the cold post-rebuild acceptance path and claim no warmup default
evidence.queryCount: benchmark-derived: carries the existing measured twenty-query acceptance workload; not a runtime query limit
evidence.samplesPerQuery: derived: one single-query measurement per deterministic query; the query set supplies the distribution
evidence.maxTextsPerRequest: derived: the synthetic-only provider admits the exact record count in one rebuild request; this is not a production provider capacity
evidence.recallAtK: benchmark-derived: carries the existing measured Recall@10 acceptance workload; not a runtime result default
evidence.minimumRecallAtK: derived acceptance invariant: each deterministic query vector exactly equals one indexed vector, so every selected query must recover its own record; not a production recall promise
evidence.hnsw.connectivity: reference-derived: explicit zero selects USearch 2.26.1's upstream connectivity default used by the established 10k baseline
evidence.hnsw.expansionAdd: reference-derived: explicit zero selects USearch 2.26.1's upstream construction-expansion default used by the established 10k baseline
evidence.hnsw.expansionSearch: reference-derived: explicit zero selects USearch 2.26.1's upstream search-expansion default used by the established 10k baseline
evidence.sqlite.busyTimeoutMs: derived: the benchmark is the sole exclusive file owner, so it performs no lock waiting or retry
evidence.memoryLimits.maxSearchTextBytes: derived: exact UTF-8 length of the largest unique-token-v1 search text at ten thousand records
evidence.memoryLimits.maxContentBytes: derived: exact canonical JSON byte length of the largest generated ordinal payload
evidence.memoryLimits.maxTagsPerMemory: derived: admitted positive minimum; this dataset writes no tags
evidence.memoryLimits.maxTagBytes: derived: admitted positive minimum; this dataset writes no tags
evidence.memoryLimits.maxRecipientsPerMemory: derived: admitted positive minimum; this dataset writes owner-visible records only
evidence.memoryLimits.maxQueryTextBytes: derived: exact UTF-8 length of the largest lexically distinct unique-token-v1 query at ten thousand records
evidence.memoryLimits.maxSelectorKinds: derived: admitted positive minimum; this dataset supplies no kind selector
evidence.memoryLimits.maxSelectorTags: derived: admitted positive minimum; this dataset supplies no tag selector
evidence.memoryLimits.maxLexicalCandidates: derived from the configured Recall@K acceptance width
evidence.memoryLimits.maxVectorCandidates: derived from the configured Recall@K acceptance width
evidence.memoryLimits.maxHydrateCandidates: derived as the maximum lexical plus vector candidate cardinality
evidence.memoryLimits.maxRecallResults: derived from the configured Recall@K acceptance width
evidence.memoryLimits.maxIndexBatchSize: derived: one explicit synthetic rebuild page covers the exact acceptance record count
evidence.memoryLimits.maxTrackedIndexPartitions: derived: this acceptance workload uses exactly one owner, timeline, and generation partition
evidence.memoryLimits.maxExportPageSize: derived: admitted positive minimum; export is outside this benchmark
evidence.memoryLimits.maxPurgeBatchSize: derived: admitted positive minimum; purge is outside this benchmark
